items.comment: Duplicate-absence write. In production the add-absence-for-employee engine recipe forces this flow, so the replay excludes the item via EngineRecipeWouldTrigger (same pattern as ts-014). The BulkAddBreaks duplicate-absence guard refuses at execution time, which the turn-eval harness never runs and therefore cannot observe; the item only keeps measuring the recipe-forcing flag, not the refusal itself.

Measures only that the model selects place_work as the write tool; client and shift ids are not resolvable in a single headless turn, so slots stay empty. The day-lock refusal is an execution-time guard the turn-eval harness does not run and cannot observe.
